documentation.content:
A Cloud Run Job execution reported `result=failed`. Common culprits:

* `loupe-migrate` — failed Alembic migration. Check the job logs; revert the bad migration if needed.
* `loupe-price-snapshot` — daily price snapshot didn't complete. Portfolio 1D deltas will be stale until the next successful run.
* `loupe-seed` — sealed-products seed regression.

Fix forward by re-running the job: `gcloud run jobs execute <name> --region=us-central1 --wait`.
